console.wrongSystem: This module is designed for the Dragonbane system

enabled.name: Enable Combat Assistant
enabled.hint: Master toggle - disables all Combat Assistant features when turned off (validation, rules, encumbrance, etc.)

delay.name: Display Delay (milliseconds)
delay.hint: How long to wait before showing rules after an action is detected

showParryDurability.name: Show Weapon Durability for Parry
showParryDurability.hint: Display weapon durability when showing parry rules (shows the damage threshold that would break the weapon)

enableParryMovementReminders.name: OPTIONAL RULE: Enable Parry Movement Reminders
enableParryMovementReminders.hint: Show the optional parry movement rule (move yourself and enemy 2m on successful parry)

enforceTargetSelection.name: Enforce Target Selection
enforceTargetSelection.hint: Require players to select a target before making any attack

enforceRangeChecking.name: Enforce Range Checking
enforceRangeChecking.hint: Validate that attacks are within weapon range (melee: up to 2m/4m for long, ranged: up to 2x base range, thrown: contextual)

enforceMonsterActionPrevention.name: Enable Monster Action Prevention
enforceMonsterActionPrevention.hint: Show confirmation dialogs before attempting parry or disarm actions against monsters (prevents invalid advancement and educates about rules)

enableShoveReminders.name: OPTIONAL RULE: Enable Shove Rule Reminders
enableShoveReminders.hint: Show shove rule reminders for melee special attacks when STR damage bonus allows it

enableDodgeMovementReminders.name: Enable Dodge Movement Reminders
enableDodgeMovementReminders.hint: Show movement reminders for successful EVADE rolls

debugMode.name: Debug Mode
debugMode.hint: Enable debug logging to console (for troubleshooting)

enableEncumbranceMonitoring.name: Enable Encumbrance Monitoring
enableEncumbranceMonitoring.hint: Automatically monitor character encumbrance and apply status effects when over-encumbered

encumbranceMonitorFolder.name: Encumbrance Monitor Folder
encumbranceMonitorFolder.hint: Name of the actor folder to monitor for encumbrance. Monitors actors in the exact folder name specified. Leave blank to monitor all characters.

encumbranceStatusEffect.name: Encumbrance Status Effect
encumbranceStatusEffect.hint: Name of the status effect to apply when over-encumbered (will be created automatically with anchor icon if it doesn't exist)

encumbranceChatNotifications.name: Encumbrance Chat Notifications
encumbranceChatNotifications.hint: Also create chat messages for encumbrance changes (in addition to UI notifications)

enableYZEIntegration.name: Enable Year Zero Engine Integration
enableYZEIntegration.hint: Automatically apply single action status effects when Year Zero Engine Combat module is installed and single action mode is enabled

yzeCustomExclusions.name: YZE Action Exclusions
yzeCustomExclusions.hint: Additional words/phrases/UUIDs to exclude from action tracking (comma-separated). These dice rolls will not trigger action status effects. See README.md for some examples. Note: Reaction spells are automatically excluded by checking their casting time.

yzeAbilityInclusions.name: YZE Action Inclusions - Abilities
yzeAbilityInclusions.hint: Heroic and Kin abilities that should count as actions (comma-separated). When these abilities are used, they will trigger action status effects. Examples: Battle Cry, Berserker, Companion, Master Carpenter, Musician, Body Slam, Hunting Instincts, Raise Spirits

enableGrudgeTracking.name: Enable Unforgiving Tracker
enableGrudgeTracking.hint: Automatically track damage dealt to Dwarf characters with Unforgiving kin ability. Creates journals for grudge lists.

enableSpellValidation.name: Enable Spell Range & Target Validation
enableSpellValidation.hint: Enable target selection and range checking for spells (same rules as weapons). All spells get Automated Animations regardless of this setting.

excludedSpells.name: Excluded Spells
excludedSpells.hint: Comma-separated list of spell names to exclude from validation. Example: 'Birdsong, Custom Spell'

enableSpellStatusEffects.name: Enable Automatic Spell Status Effects
enableSpellStatusEffects.hint: Automatically apply status effects when spells are successfully cast.

enableAASupport.name: Enable AA Support
enableAASupport.label: Enable Automated Animations
enableAASupport.hint: Add compatibility data to all spells so they can trigger Automated Animations. This modifies spell data by adding 'n/a' to empty damage fields.

disableAASupport.name: Disable AA Support
disableAASupport.label: Disable Automated Animations
disableAASupport.hint: Remove compatibility data from enhanced spells to disable Automated Animations. This removes 'n/a' from spell damage fields that were added by the enable function.

setupGrudgeFolders.name: Setup Grudge Folders
setupGrudgeFolders.label: Setup Grudge Folders
setupGrudgeFolders.hint: Create grudge folders and journals for all player characters with the Unforgiving ability. Run this once when starting your game or when new PCs join.

aoeRuleReminder.name: AOE Rule Reminder
aoeRuleReminder.hint: Show rule reminders before casting area of effect spells (sphere and cone spells)

customWeaponFeatures.name: Custom Weapon Features
customWeaponFeatures.hint: Add custom weapon features (comma-separated). Optionally add a tooltip after a '|'. Example: 'Articulated, Wounding|Inflicts an extra wound on a critical hit'. These appear in weapon feature checkboxes for any weapon; the tooltip shows on hover.

enableAA.title: Enable Automated Animations Support
enableAA.content: This will add 'n/a' to the damage field of all non-damage spells, making them compatible with Automated Animations.
enableAA.warning: This affects all actors and their spells in your world. Easily reversible with the disable button.

disableAA.title: Disable Automated Animations Support
disableAA.content: This will remove 'n/a' from the damage field of enhanced spells, disabling Automated Animations compatibility.
disableAA.warning: This affects all actors and their spells in your world. You can re-enable anytime.

setupGrudgeFolders.title: Setup Grudge Folders
setupGrudgeFolders.content: This will create grudge folders and journals for all player characters with the Unforgiving ability. Any existing journals will be preserved.
setupGrudgeFolders.info: Only characters with the Unforgiving kin ability will have journals created.

aoeReminder.dodgeRule: Area of effect spells can be dodged but not parried, unless stated otherwise.
aoeReminder.exemptRule: You can exempt one or more targets within the area from the spell's effects, but you then get a bane on the roll.
